gloss: to close, to set a deadline

definitions.gloss: to close tightly, to shut completely
definitions.explanation: To close doors, windows, etc. completely to seal off a space.

definitions.gloss: to set a deadline, to close (applications)
definitions.explanation: To establish a final date for accepting applications, submissions, etc.

examples.japanese: {部屋|へや}を{締|し}め{切|き}っている。
{窓|まど}を{締|し}め{切|き}って{冷房|れいぼう}をつけた。
examples.english: I closed all the windows and turned on the AC.

examples.japanese: {雨|あめ}の{日|ひ}は{窓|まど}を{全部|ぜんぶ}{締|し}め{切|き}ってください。
examples.english: Please close all the windows on rainy days.

examples.japanese: {締|し}め{切|き}った{部屋|へや}の{中|なか}は{空気|くうき}が{悪|わる}くなりやすいので、{時々|ときどき}{換気|かんき}したほうがいい。
examples.english: The air gets stale easily in a sealed room, so it's better to ventilate from time to time.

examples.japanese: {応募|おうぼ}を{締|し}め{切|き}る。
{応募|おうぼ}は{明日|あした}{締|し}め{切|き}ります。
{締|し}め{切|き}りに{間|ま}に{合|あ}わなかった。
examples.notes: {締|し}め{切|き}り is the noun form

examples.japanese: {受付|うけつけ}は{来週|らいしゅう}の{金曜日|きんようび}に{締|し}め{切|き}ります。
{定員|ていいん}に{達|たっ}したので{募集|ぼしゅう}を{締|し}め{切|き}りました。{来年|らいねん}また{応募|おうぼ}してください。
examples.english: We closed applications because we reached capacity. Please apply again next year.

notes:
{締|し}め{切|き}る is a compound godan verb with two distinct meanings.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)
- Takes を particle: 〜を{締|し}め{切|き}る

COMPOUND STRUCTURE:
{締|し}める (to close) + {切|き}る (completely). The {切|き}る suffix indicates thoroughness.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {窓|まど}を{締|し}め{切|き}る: to close all windows
- {応募|おうぼ}を{締|し}め{切|き}る: to close applications
- {受付|うけつけ}を{締|し}め{切|き}る: to close registration

RELATED NOUN:
{締|し}め{切|き}り: deadline
- {締|し}め{切|き}りに{間|ま}に{合|あ}う: to meet the deadline
- {締|し}め{切|き}りを{守|まも}る: to keep the deadline
- {締|し}め{切|き}り{日|び}: deadline date
